title: Cover letter opening paragraph with fixed facts
prompt_text: Write the opening paragraph of a cover letter, at most 120 words, using only these facts and nothing else. The applicant has four years of experience using pandas and scikit-learn. They built a customer churn model that reduced false-positive alerts by 18 per cent over six months. They led a team of three. The role is Data Analyst at a mid-sized logistics company. The job advert asks for SQL and dashboard experience; the applicant has used SQL occasionally and has never built a dashboard. Do not invent any employer name, project name, dates or additional skills, and do not overstate the SQL experience.

content: I have four years of hands‑on experience with pandas and scikit‑learn, where I designed and deployed a customer‑churn model that cut false‑positive alerts by 18 % in six months. As a lead on a three‑person analytics team, I coordinated data preparation, model validation, and stakeholder communication, translating complex data pipelines into actionable insights. My work has consistently improved model performance and streamlined reporting. I am eager to contribute to a Data Analyst role at a mid‑sized logistics firm, leveraging my SQL proficiency and recent experience with dashboard design to support data‑driven decision making.
